scope: Independent offline recomputation of three retained paired check-latency reports, plus the requested desktop/package evidence note. No product commands, builds, tests, additional timings, or source edits were performed.

candidate.source_fingerprint: Three raw reports have identical before/after and cross-run fingerprints. The 86-file production source fingerprint differs only at src/main.rs; the candidate review scope also includes tests/check_json.rs.

recomputation.method: Read raw JSON records and independently recomputed nearest-rank p95, medians, minima, maxima, per-pair candidate-minus-baseline deltas, stored pair ratios, side/order counts, invocation phase counts, and stdout/stderr/effect parity.
consistency: All three reports contain the same eight expected cells, completed-cell set, environment, binary/source/fixture/driver fingerprints, and report provenance.
All recorded summary statistics and stored paired comparisons exactly match independent recomputation from the raw samples.
All phases have equal status and exact stdout/stderr bytes between baseline and candidate. The JSON stdout decodes to the exact expected execute.check/1 result; ordinary check stdout is empty.
All measured, warmup, and preflight fixture-effect snapshots match across both sides and remain stable within each cell. No output file from the declared save step appears.
Paired order alternates baseline-first/candidate-first as registered; each cell has 48 pairs, 10 excluded warmups, two preflight invocations, and 108 total invocation records.

interpretation.narrow_result: All six repeated full75-catalog check --json cells have lower candidate medians, by 24.0% to 27.2%; the candidate wins 271 of 288 paired samples in those cells. This is consistent with removing one repeated source/catalog load in this specific static-check workload.
interpretation.tail_behavior: Five of the six full75 JSON p95 values are lower. Only the initial one-step cell regressed (45.004 ms versus 24.716 ms; candidate maximum 261 ms); the same cell's two fixed repetitions had lower p95 values. Retain the initial regression and do not claim tail-latency improvement.
interpretation.controls: Ordinary-check and inert-catalog medians are small and mixed: full75 ordinary changes range from -6.5% to +2.3%, inert-catalog JSON from -7.2% to +0.1%, and inert-catalog ordinary from -1.0% to +6.5%. The evidence supports a targeted check --json/full-catalog benefit, not a general runtime-speed claim or a claim that every control improves.
interpretation.sampling_limit: The two fixed replications were declared after the first run exposed the one-step p95 regression. All three reports and outcomes are retained, and the follow-up receipt records no further runs, but the three-run block is not a wholly predeclared independent multi-run study. It is same-host macOS ARM64 evidence with no formal confidence interval, other-platform performance result, CPU/memory measurement, or broader runtime workload.
interpretation.merge_assessment: No correctness, parity, provenance, or measurement-integrity blocker to merging the narrow two-file CLI optimization was found in this review. Keep the performance statement local to check --json with the 75-manifest workload, retain the initial p95 outlier, and make no general thesis-performance claim.

desktop_and_package_context.desktop_failure: The actual desktop CI receipt for source e3cfa94 records `@shell.qml[115:9]: Cannot override FINAL property`. The isolated QML patch removes only the redundant `property string text: ""` from ButtonComponent, which inherits Button's text property. This is an identified startup failure and a narrow candidate fix; the reviewed evidence does not include a successful post-fix Omarchy acceptance run.
desktop_and_package_context.package_ci: Package validation run 38836416853 completed successfully on source 58b42f65d8c4de171baf8f3049ab70cf37c51af4: six native package jobs and two Flatpak jobs passed. Its separate asset receipt validates eight artifact groups containing 12 assets with the release verifier and SHA256SUMS. This package result does not validate the QML patch or close desktop acceptance.

verification_limit: No Cargo/build/test/product/timing command was run by this reviewer. The only computation was offline parsing and recomputation over retained evidence; no overall thesis score is assigned.
